question: What family secret did you find out way too late?
story: My grandmother was banned from her own church bake sale for twelve years, and nobody in my family would tell me why. The story I got as a kid was that she stopped baking. She had not stopped baking. She baked constantly. She just was not allowed to bring anything to the fall festival, and every October she would make a pie anyway and eat it in the living room like a threat. I asked my mom once. My mom changed the subject so fast she gave herself hiccups. Last Christmas my aunt finally cracked. Back in the nineties, my grandmother won the pie contest four years straight. On the fifth year, the pastor's wife suggested she sit one out to give others a chance. So she entered anyway, under a fake name, in my uncle's handwriting. She won. Then she stood up and announced it to the entire congregation. She is eighty six. She still has the ribbon.
